summary_1line: After chaos arises among beings, divine order is restored through the creation of Chastisement (Danda) and the appointment of cosmic rulers to maintain righteousness.

image_candidates.scene_text: Mahadeva, holding a massive trident, manifests the embodiment of Chastisement as divine forces gather to restore order to a chaotic world.
The gods assemble as Shiva appoints Indra, Varuna, Yama, and other deities as rulers over their respective realms of the universe.
In a cosmic chain of transmission, the rod of chastisement passes from the gods through sages to Manu, symbolizing the origin of royal authority.
